topic: Creating virtual session mapping and data cleanup
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on creating a mapping of sessions based on existing linking data, followed by the deletion of previous session records. [me] provided an SQL script template for virtual insertions from the AllUnite data science repository but noted that direct deletion was problematic and suggested [p1] would handle it.

[p1] requested parameters for the script, specifically mentioning a date (2025-09-01) and a number (7975).

[p1] also inquired whether the `created` date in `facility_virtual` affects the provided SQL script, to which [me] confirmed it does not.
decisions: The session mapping will be based on existing linking data.
action_items: [me] needs to provide parameters for the virtual insertion script (SQL template) to [p1].
